title: Measuring Social Norms of Large Language Models
findings: The paper does not report findings specifically for religious knowledge. The results are aggregated under the 'Social Studies' category. Overall, models like LLaMA2-70B-Chat and GPT-3.5-Turbo achieved high accuracy (90.4% and 91.9% respectively) on Social Studies questions, which include factual questions about world religions. The proposed SocialAgent method further improved these scores, making the models' performance on par with that of elementary school students.
